review.reason: The answer fairly states that the cited passages do not define a standalone term and supports the SI-to-scope relationship only as a mapping of SI/PCB validation topics and instrument categories, with explicit limits on product configurations. The only notable overreach is framing VNA/probing/de-embedding as a choice 'rather than a scope,' since the passages describe those cases but do not explicitly make that comparative decision.
